mock_interviews.title: Mock Interview — Data Structures & Algorithms (DSA)
mock_interviews.description: Master algorithmic thinking, problem-solving patterns, and optimization techniques. This interview challenges your ability to analyze time-space complexity and implement efficient solutions for complex computational problems.
mock_interviews.instructions: Algorithm analysis, problem-solving patterns, and coding tasks with multiple test cases. Focus on optimization and edge cases.

ai_context.context: Focus on Arrays, Strings, Linked Lists, Trees, Graphs, and Dynamic Programming.
predefined_questions: Could you explain what a Hash Table is and how it handles collisions?
Explain the difference between a BFS and DFS traversal in a graph.
What is Dynamic Programming, and can you give an example of a problem where it's useful?
Walk me through how you would find the middle of a linked list in a single pass.
Great, now please write a function in Python that takes a list of integers and returns the two numbers that add up to a specific target.

mock_interviews.title: Mock Interview — Python Development
mock_interviews.description: Comprehensive assessment of Python programming skills, including language internals, asynchronous programming, web frameworks, and data processing.
mock_interviews.instructions: Python syntax, decorators, generators, multi-threading vs multi-processing.

ai_context.context: Focus on Pythonic idioms (PEP 8), memory management, GIL, async/await, and library usage.
predefined_questions: What are decorators in Python, and how would you use them?
Explain the difference between a list and a tuple, and when would you use one over the other?
What is the Global Interpreter Lock (GIL) and how does it affect multi-threading in Python?
How does memory management work in Python? Mention garbage collection.
Please write a Python decorator that logs the execution time of any function it wraps.

mock_interviews.title: Mock Interview — HR & Behavioral
mock_interviews.description: Behavioral assessment focusing on cultural fit, career aspirations, soft skills, and alignment with company values.
mock_interviews.instructions: Behavioral questions, situational scenarios, career discussions, and value alignment conversations.

ai_context.context: Focus on conflict resolution, leadership potential, adaptability, and communication skills.
predefined_questions: Tell me about yourself and why you're interested in this role.
Describe a situation where you had a conflict with a team member and how you resolved it.
What are your long-term career goals, and how does this company fit into them?
What is your biggest weakness, and how are you working to improve it?
Why should we hire you over other candidates with similar technical backgrounds?
